comments:
The entry No. 16070 in [8H6M69W4] (mdzod kyi gnas gsal bar byed pa zla ba' 'od zer; dge slong blo gros seng ge; phyi dza 8, 38 fols.) corresponds to manuscripts (ID:7304), (ID:5893), and (ID:4535), which are written with continuous folio numbering. 
The present text is found on fols. 1b1-22b7.
While [8H6M69W4], No. 16070 reports the signature phyi dza 8, the signature on the present item reads "phyi ang? 215."
